messages:
Elaine: Need a compact launch bundle for the benchmark webinar (Wed 3/3). Main asks: hero image, 3-card social carousel + animated variant, and a single-slide diagram suitable for the deck. Need Figma source + exportables. cc @Jordan
Jordan: Got it. Confirming output formats and sizes?
Elaine: Yes — Figma file, PNG/JPG for web, GIF for small animation, MP4 optional for paid channels. Sizes: hero 1920x1080 + 1200x628; carousel 1080x1080 (x3); slide 1600x900 vector export. Also require an accessible high-contrast color set and an inverse white-on-dark version for socials.
Sam: Do we need translations or just EN?
Elaine: EN for this push but design should tolerate ~+25% line length for short translations.
Nic: If we run paid promos we need filename convention + UTM template. I'll also need the asset manifest CSV to wire into tracking.
Elaine: Good call. Please provide the UTM pattern and example filenames.
Nic: Use: ?utm_source=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_mar23&utm_content={asset}
Jordan: Proposed deliverables:
- Hero: 1920x1080 + 1200x628 (PNG/JPG)
- Carousel: 3 slides 1080x1080 static + animated GIF/MP4
- Deck diagram: 1600x900 SVG + PNG for slides
- Figma master file + export folder
- Asset manifest CSV (filename, variant, size, CTA_label, utm, notes)
Jordan: Accessibility targets: contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text, >= 3:1 for large text. I will run the color pass and produce notes.
Elaine: For the content visuals, use the latest benchmark metrics — small inline sparklines next to stats. Tiny sample data for layouts (use micro-sparklines):
```
metric,median_ms,cost_per_1k
search,45,0.12
chat,120,0.35
embed,6,0.05
```
Jordan: Sparklines as subtle 1-row lines aligned to the right of the stat. Good.
Sam: CTA copy options (short / mid / long):
- Short: "Watch the benchmark"
- Mid: "See how we cut inference costs"
- Long: "Join our webinar: real-world latency & cost benchmarks"
Jordan: I'll export three CTA-labeled variants: CTA_short / CTA_mid / CTA_long.
Elaine: Filename convention suggestion: benchmark_hero_1920x1080_v1_EN.png, benchmark_carousel_slide1_1080x1080_v1_EN.gif, benchmark_diagram_1600x900_v1_EN.svg
Nic: That works. For paid assets replace _EN with region codes as needed.
assets-bot: upload slot reserved: marketing/bench-launch/1750001234/ — upload final export zip there when ready. :package:
Jordan: Timeline: I can post a first-pass screenshot by tomorrow 11:30am PST if I get final copy and the Figma link now. Final deliverables by EOD Tuesday.
Elaine: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-brief — it has styles, logo SVGs, and master components.
Jordan: Checklist for handoff (I'll include each in the export zip):
- Figma source file link and version note
- Export folder with PNG/JPG/GIF/MP4/SVG
- asset-manifest.csv (filename, width, height, variant, CTA_label, utm, intended_use)
- accessibility-notes.txt (contrast ratios, alt text guidance)
- slides-ready PNG for deck deliverable
Elaine: Also include a short usage note for hero vs. social cropping (safe area).
Sam: I'll finalize the CTA selection by 9:30am tomorrow. Also flagging: if we add EU translations later, we may need diacritics QA for font rendering.
Jordan: Will leave baseline spacing to accommodate diacritics. Also creating three color variants + one animation variant.
Nic: After CTA locked I'll post the UTM-tracking sheet with exact mappings to filenames.
Elaine: Thanks all — ping if blocked. :pray:
Jordan: Posting first-pass shots here when ready.
Sam: :thumbsup:
assets-bot: reminder scheduled: set uploaded files to visibility=team-marketing on upload.
